title: Philippine wildfire-onset label audit (Mindanao-first)
target_label: New wildfire start in a 5 km square during the next Philippine 24 hours

incidents.accept_rule: Verified Philippine local onset date (day precision) that maps to one midnight-to-midnight forecast window, location resolves to one 5 km square, not ongoing, wildfire_class not structural.

coverage.accept_rule: reporting_adequate=true and location resolves to one 5 km square. Unmonitored days remain unknown.

incidents.accept_rule: Verified Philippine local onset date (day precision) that maps to one midnight-to-midnight forecast window, location resolves to one 5 km square, not ongoing, wildfire_class not structural.

coverage.accept_rule: reporting_adequate=true and location resolves to one 5 km square. Unmonitored days remain unknown.

stronger_label_warning: Only day-precision onset rows with point/barangay locations are accepted as positives. Report-only dates, ongoing fires, and ambiguous locations remain unknown.
